item.title: Matka Studios
item.description:
Oh, and this part is more from my game development/content production side… I’m currently producing and directing videos for the Matka Studios channel, a project focused on game development, creative experimentation, and the behind-the-scenes process of building games and a studio from the ground up.

This portfolio section showcases the audiovisual content, editing, creative direction, and production workflows developed for the channel, combining cinematic storytelling, marketing, and game industry communication into a single ongoing project.

item.title: Cronic Digital
item.description: Oh, and this part is more from my marketing/audiovisual side… I worked alongside Cronic Digital for over five years directing and producing campaigns, branded content, and commercial projects, while also experimenting a lot with AI workflows inside production and post-production.

item.title: Jimmy Kim TV
item.description: Here’s a bit from my YouTube Vlog/Trip/Food editing side… I edited 27+ videos for Jimmy Kim TV in 2025, mostly around travel, food, and experience content, focusing a lot on pacing, storytelling, and keeping that natural vlog feeling throughout the edits.

item.title: Lixo Carmesim
item.description:
A little different from the usual stuff, but this was a stop-motion short film I worked on in 2024, handling rig removal, cleanup, and post-production frame by frame across 4,000+ frames using Photoshop and After Effects over the course of about three months.

Click here to watch the film.

item.title: La Mondo En Ekvilibro
item.description: Oh yeah, this project went into a way more conceptual and cinematic direction… created for La Mondo en Ekvilibro, it explores ideas around the Mondo token, environmental preservation, and humanity’s impact on nature through a mix of AI, stock footage, motion graphics, and my own direction and editing work.

item.title: Nice N Raw
item.description:
Oh, and this was a more hands-on YouTube project… I worked on direction, production, and editing for the Nice N Raw channel, handling everything from camera work and on-set direction to the full post-production process in Premiere Pro and After Effects, always focusing on storytelling, pacing, and building a consistent visual identity for the channel.

Check the videos

item.title: Art Direction | Design
item.description: Oh, so you ended up on the designer side of my portfolio… here are some visual identity and brand application projects I worked on for different brands, mostly focused on visual direction, layouts, assets, and helping expand the branding across digital and print.
